source: The Alpaca MCP connector's tool schemas and Alpaca's own server's tool list, read 2026-11-14. Every tool here writes to the account. A tool with an inert reason has no rule in hooks/presets/alpaca.json on purpose.

cancel_order_by_id.inert: Removes an open order and opens no position. It can remove a stop order the owner set, which docs/HOOK.md lists as not covered.

cancel_all_orders.inert: Removes open orders and opens no position. It can remove a stop order the owner set, which docs/HOOK.md lists as not covered.

create_watchlist.inert: A list of symbols on the Alpaca side. It places no order.

update_watchlist_by_id.inert: A list of symbols on the Alpaca side. It places no order.

delete_watchlist_by_id.inert: A list of symbols on the Alpaca side. It places no order.

add_asset_to_watchlist_by_id.inert: A list of symbols on the Alpaca side. It places no order.

remove_asset_from_watchlist_by_id.inert: A list of symbols on the Alpaca side. It places no order.

create_locate.inert: Alpaca's own server lists it for a short sale and says it is not available in paper trading. The hosted connector has no such tool. It places no order.
